subject: E-3344: crash on launch on Android
body:
Hi, I'm using MeshMail 2.8.5 on Android 14 (Galaxy S23). Since Monday, every time I log in, I get
'E-3344: application crashed on launch'.

It crashes since the update that installed itself this morning. No other change was made to the
machine.

What I tried so far: waiting a day. No luck.

Regards, Grace Okafor, Ferro & Sons
